lines.text: Many learners say: I have a question to you.
Better: I have a question for you.
For! I have a question for you.

data.wrong: I have a question to you.
data.right: I have a question for you.
data.memory: I have a question for you.

native.tip: 質問を向ける相手には for を使い、a question for you と言います。
native.caption: “I have a question to you.”と言っていませんか？😅 「あなたに」の「に」につられて to にしがちです。“I have a question for you.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“for”。“I have a question for you.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “I have a question to you.” 😅 The Japanese に makes people choose to. The natural way is “I have a question for you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
